login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your phone number and password to continue.
login.endedNotice: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.passwordResetDone: Your password was changed. Please sign in with the new password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your phone number and we will send a verification code if an account exists.
forgot.privacyNote: For your security, we show the same confirmation whether or not the number belongs to an account.

verify.title: Enter the verification code
verify.subtitle: If an account exists for {{phone}}, a code was sent to it.
verify.genericNotice: The same message is shown for every number, so this screen does not confirm that an account exists.
verify.otpHint: Enter the code exactly as you received it.
verify.expired: The code's validity period has ended. Request a new code.
verify.requestNew: Request a new code or change the number

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account. You will sign in again afterwards.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Use a password that is different from your current one.
changePassword.forcedBody: Your account uses a temporary password. Change it to continue to the rest of the app.
changePassword.otherDevicesNote: Changing your password signs you out of your other devices. This device stays signed in.
changePassword.successBody: Your password was updated and this device stays signed in. Your other devices were signed out.

devices.title: My devices
devices.subtitle: The devices currently signed in to your account.
devices.confirmBody: “{{device}}” will be signed out. Your other devices are not affected.
devices.confirmCurrentBody: You will be signed out here and taken to the sign-in screen. Your other devices stay signed in.
devices.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
devices.logoutAllBody: End every session of your account, including this one.
devices.logoutAllConfirmBody: You will be signed out on every device, including this one, and will need to sign in again.

logout.confirmBody: You will be signed out of this device only. Your other devices stay signed in.
